objective: Improved solver and iteration methods tested sufficiently to prepare next training

requirements.research: Exact implicit equation and Jacobian, PSD limit, line-search/finite-bisection energy and gradient assumptions grounded in code and primary sources
requirements.implementation: Per-sample Armijo, bounded bisection, strict original tolerance, executed-branch gradients and diagnostics
requirements.local_validation: Real failure capture; branch FD; NaN and singularity; batch independence; energy ledger; migration and bounded resume
requirements.cuda_numerical_validation: Same nontrivial numerical/gradient suite on CUDA
requirements.actual_training: Cross original failure and K16 transition with original full-budget schedule; K32 parameter updates using trained weights
requirements.autonomous_inference: All384 seen validation initial histories,320 steps; finite states/ledger and cost. In addition to stress-weight rollout, direct full-batch model.rollout on normal-schedule4250 checkpoint must pass without evaluator batch-splitting retries.
requirements.reproducibility: Frozen code/data hashes, explicit solver-only migration provenance and recoverable bounded-run checkpoints
requirements.handoff: Validated config and executable next-training path; evidence-based runtime and limits; no claim of universal future stability
